nrccMessages.Value: Trains running between Wolverhampton and Shrewsbury / Stafford may be delayed by up to 60 minutes or revised. Latest information can be found in the Disruptions area of the National Rail website.

Trains between Bristol Parkway and Gloucester / Swindon may still be cancelled, delayed by up to 45 minutes or revised. Further information can be found in the Disruptions area of the National Rail website.
